// P-FLOW-01 GREEN fixture: a tenant-scoped query — the tenant-predicate lint admits it (the tenant
// predicate is threaded on the statement, so RLS + the tenant-first PK isolate the read).
fn dispatch() {
    let runs = sqlx::query("SELECT * FROM workflow_run WHERE state = 'running'").with_tenant(tenant_id).fetch_all(&pool).await?;
}
